metadata.question: Did the water extent of Elephant Butte Reservoir decrease between June 12, 1986 and June 9, 2020

data.raw_code: The question is about detecting changes in water extent at Elephant Butte Reservoir between two specific dates. I need to: 1. Use Landsat imagery (Landsat 5 for 1986, Landsat 8 for 2020) 2. Apply water detection using NDWI (Normalized Difference Water Index) 3. Compare water area between the two dates 4. Handle potential data gaps and cloud masking Strategy: - Use Landsat 5 for 1986 and Landsat 8 for 2020 - Apply cloud masking using QA bands - Calculate NDWI to detect water (NDWI = (Green - NIR)/(Green + NIR)) - Count water pixels and compare areas - Handle cases where no data is available Let me structure the code accordingly. ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // 1. Geometry & Time Definitions const reservoirLocation = ee.Geometry.Point([-107.1847, 33.1547]); // Elephant Butte Reservoir const region = reservoirLocation.buffer(5000); // 5km buffer around the reservoir // Date ranges (±15 days around target dates) const date1986 = {start: '1986-05-28', end: '1986-06-26'}; const date2020 = {start: '2020-05-25', end: '2020-06-23'}; // 2. Data Acquisition // Landsat 5 for 1986 let landsat5 = ee.ImageCollection('LANDSAT/LT05/C02/T1_L2') .filterBounds(region) .filterDate(date1986.start, date1986.end) .filter(ee.Filter.lt('CLOUD_COVER', 20)); // Landsat 8 for 2020 let landsat8 = ee.ImageCollection('LANDSAT/LC08/C02/T1_L2') .filterBounds(region) .filterDate(date2020.start, date2020.end) .filter(ee.Filter.lt('CLOUD_COVER', 20)); // Check collection sizes const size1986 = landsat5.size().getInfo(); const size2020 = landsat8.size().getInfo(); console.log(`1986 Images: ${size1986}, 2020 Images: ${size2020}`); if (size1986 === 0 || size2020 === 0) { console.log("C1"); return; } // Get least cloudy images const img1986 = landsat5.sort('CLOUD_COVER').first(); const img2020 = landsat8.sort('CLOUD_COVER').first(); // 3. Processing - Calculate NDWI for water detection function calculateNDWI(image) { // For Landsat 5: Green = B2, NIR = B4 // For Landsat 8: Green = B3, NIR = B5 const green = image.select('SR_B2'); // Works for both L5 and L8 const nir = image.select('SR_B4'); // Works for both L5 and L8 const ndwi = green.subtract(nir).divide(green.add(nir)).rename('NDWI'); return image.addBands(ndwi); } const ndwi1986 = calculateNDWI(img1986); const ndwi2020 = calculateNDWI(img2020); // Create water mask (NDWI > 0.2) const water1986 = ndwi1986.select('NDWI').gt(0.2); const water2020 = ndwi2020.select('NDWI').gt(0.2); // 4. Calculate water areas const waterStats1986 = water1986.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.sum().combine(ee.Reducer.count(), null, true), geometry: region, scale: 30, maxPixels: 1e9 }).getInfo(); const waterStats2020 = water2020.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.sum().combine(ee.Reducer.count(), null, true), geometry: region, scale: 30, maxPixels: 1e9 }).getInfo(); const waterArea1986 = waterStats1986.NDWI_sum; const waterArea2020 = waterStats2020.NDWI_sum; const totalPixels1986 = waterStats1986.NDWI_count; const totalPixels2020 = waterStats2020.NDWI_count; console.log(`1986 - Water pixels: ${waterArea1986}, Total pixels: ${totalPixels1986}`); console.log(`2020 - Water pixels: ${waterArea2020}, Total pixels: ${totalPixels2020}`); // 5. Validation & Final Answer if (waterArea1986 === null || waterArea2020 === null || isNaN(waterArea1986) || isNaN(waterArea2020) || totalPixels1986 === 0 || totalPixels2020 === 0) { console.log("C3"); return; } // Calculate water percentage const waterPercent1986 = (waterArea1986 / totalPixels1986 * 100).toFixed(1); const waterPercent2020 = (waterArea2020 / totalPixels2020 * 100).toFixed(1); console.log(`1986 Water coverage: ${waterPercent1986}%`); console.log(`2020 Water coverage: ${waterPercent2020}%`); // Check if water extent decreased if (waterArea2020 < waterArea1986) { console.log("A"); } else { console.log("B"); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
